mechanism: Mexiletine may inhibit hepatic metabolism of progesterone via CYP3A4 and CYP2D6, potentially increasing progesterone levels; progesterone may also affect mexiletine clearance through CYP1A2 inhibition.
action: Monitor for increased progesterone-related side effects (nausea, headache, breast tenderness) and mexiletine efficacy; consider baseline and follow-up mexiletine levels if available; adjust doses if needed based on clinical response.
